title: Separate compilation/export plans
requirement: WHEN a bounded step is prepared for a backend, tooling SHALL report separate ConstraintPlan and WitnessPlan artifacts with their BackendCapabilities disposition.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Structured witness export and unsupported features
scenarios.when: One step uses structured witness instructions and a requested export also encounters a native witness closure, lookup or interaction.
scenarios.then: OperationManifest identifies typed operations, ordered inputs/outputs, source/component membership and omissions; constraint export, witness-program export, lookup/interact/custom-gate support and field/layout support are listed separately. Unsupported features yield tooling Unsupported, with no claim that basic constraint JSON supplies witness computation or that any non-Midnight format is a Midnight/ZKIR exporter.
scenarios.judgment: Evaluator reading (UIREQ-031 + interfaces.md 'Witness, constraints and exports' + D31): one bounded K-A step of fact(3) is prepared twice (the final checked multiplication, a scalar step, and a ReturnF frame return). Each must yield a content-addressed OperationManifest, separate ConstraintPlan and WitnessPlan sharing it, BackendCapabilities with lookup/interaction/custom-gate/structured-witness/native-closure/field-layout listed separately, emitted constraint and structured-witness artifacts whose bytes the holdout hashes, and a located tooling Unsupported for at least one of native closure/lookup/interaction, with the application run unchanged. Each capability requested alone gives the same disposition and bytes. Steps that perform no arithmetic (a return into LeftF(Mul), which only schedules the right operand, and a return through ScopeF that has RightF(Mul) below it) must not list any CheckedU128* operation: a manifest that names an operation the selected step does not perform does not 'identify' that step's typed operations. The ops such a step SHOULD list are not asserted. (Added 2026-10-26 after sherlock-quint-3 showed that a classifier scanning pending frames reported Mul for rule 195.)
unasserted: the exact operation decomposition beyond the presence of CheckedU128Mul (scalar step) and FrameRestore (frame step)
the security interpretation of constraint components (Opus-owned)
any actual proof or Midnight export (none is claimed)
